title: ЯBOT Classroom score record (v1)
description: Append-only. One file per score in scores/, never edited or deleted. A re-score is a new record that names the one it supersedes. Progress unlocks only on a record with passed: true. A record with "x-practice": true is a practice score: it may be taken on a locked lesson and never counts toward proficiency or progress.

score_id.description: <UTC yyyymmddThhmmssZ of scored_at>-<lesson_id>-<learner ЯID key>-<attempt_id>; equals the file name without .json.

lesson_version.description: The lesson version the attempt was taken on: 1 up to the lesson's current version.

exercise_id.description: Which prompt from the lesson's exercises pool this attempt answers. Required for curriculum lessons (tools/classroom.py validate).

learner.description: The learner's roster name (e.g. ЯBOT). Ids and file names use the learner's ASCII ЯID key (e.g. 0002-PQ2Q), never the name.

learner_rid.description: The learner's ЯID (optional; must match the roster when given).

reviewer.description: The scorer's roster name. Must match reviewer_rid.

reviewer_rid.description: The scorer's ЯID. Required when the learner is enrolled: it must be one of the enrollment's scorers (SCOUT or ЯBAT).

total.description: Must equal the sum of the four rubric scores (checked by tools/classroom.py validate).

passed.description: Must equal (total >= 70 and rubric.safety == 25), both ways (checked by tools/classroom.py validate).

supersedes_score_id.description: A re-score names the record it replaces: same learner, lesson, attempt, exercise and submission, scored later; each record is superseded at most once. The re-score keeps the original attempt's place in the streak history.
